capabilities: Open a Space leader menu of commands with customizable keymap files
Navigate Reading view with Vimium-style keys and letter-labeled link hints
Jump the cursor to on-screen characters or words by typing labels
Pin files as numbered marks and jump back to them Harpoon-style
Run .obsidian.vimrc mappings and switch keyboard layout between Insert and Normal modes
disambiguation: Not a text editor replacement; it layers Vim-style keys on top of Obsidian's existing editor and Reading view.
extras: Desktop only. Layout switching is off by default and requires installing a small external command-line tool. It can import existing Spacekeys keymaps, Harpoon lists and .obsidian.vimrc files, and keeps replaced plugins' matching features off until they are disabled.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's Vim mode only works while you edit a note; Vim Layer adds the rest
problem: Obsidian's built-in Vim key bindings only work while editing a note; there is no Vim-style control in Reading view, no leader menu, and no layout handling for non-Latin keyboards.

relations.evidence: Vim Layer covers Spacekeys, Vimium+, Harpoon, Vim IM Control, Vimrc Support and the editor jumps of Jump to link
relations.plugin: Spacekeys, Vimium+, Harpoon, Vim IM Control, Vimrc Support, Jump to link

requires.name: macism, im-select, or fcitx5-remote command-line tool

summary: Vim-keys extension that adds a Space leader menu, Vimium-style Reading-view navigation, labeled jumps, Harpoon-style file marks, .vimrc mappings and layout switching.
